posts.title: Turning Light Into Sight: How the 2026 Nobel Prize in Optogenetics Is Transforming Treatment for Retinitis Pigmentosa and Beyond
posts.summary: A microscopic green alga gave scientists a molecular light switch for living nerve cells. Recognized with the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine, optogenetics is bringing landmark vision restoration therapies to patients with late-stage retinitis pigmentosa and opening new frontiers across medicine.
